shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').version\"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n -maxdepth 3 -iname '*readme*' -o -iname '*docs*' | head -30; rg -n \"keyset|I18n|configure|registerKeysets\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.md' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit deps/version ---'; node -p \"JSON.stringify({version:require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version,i18n:require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').dependencies['@gravity-ui/i18n']},null,2)\"; printf '%s\\n' '--- configure API ---'; rg -n \"export declare function configure|declare function configure|type Lang|interface Config\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; rg -n \"configure\\(\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -30; printf '%s\\n' '--- Select docs ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -iname '*select*' -print | head; printf '%s\\n' '--- Select dts ---'; rg -n \"interface SelectProps|type SelectProps|size.*.*'s'|onUpdate\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export (declare )?(const|function) (Flex|Text)|interface FlexProps|type TextVariant|interface TextProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -l \"Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -20; rg -n \"interface FlexProps|export declare const Flex|export declare const Row|export declare const Col\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; rg -n \"'header-|'body-|'caption-\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text -g '*.d.ts' | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export type Space|type Space\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout -g '*.d.ts' | head -10; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; node -p \"require('./package.json').dependencies['@gravity-ui/i18n']\"; sed -n '1,160p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- hook ---\\n'; cat src/hooks/use-app-language.ts"
